# pai budget

The local-only budget window: local-only, status, approve

```
pai budget [command]
```

`pai budget local-only --until "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"` closes the cloud machine-wide until that time; `off` reopens it. While open, cloud starts and automatic cloud moves are refused with "local-only window until <time> (budget): ask the PAI session to approve a cloud run"; the gatekeeper session approves single runs through (`pai budget approve`). The operator's own reroutes always pass.

```sh
pai budget local-only --until "2026-11-21 07:00"
pai budget status
pai budget approve 20261118-211428-86670
```

See also: `pai worker mode`, `pai freeze`

### pai budget local-only

The machine-wide local-only window: no cloud starts until --until (off closes it)

```
pai budget local-only [off] [options]
```

While the window is open every session's cloud start (--cloud, --provider/--where naming a cloud provider, a class whose route resolves to the cloud) is refused, automatic escalation never targets the cloud, and reroutes to the cloud are refused. The operator's own moves (pai worker reroute, the cockpit) always pass; the gatekeeper session (`pai budget approve`, config key budget.gatekeeper, default "PAI") can open a one-time exception.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `off` | no | "off" closes the window; with --until it opens it |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--until WHEN` | string | — | Close the cloud until this local time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" (e.g. "2026-11-21 07:00") |

```sh
pai budget local-only --until "2026-11-21 07:00"
pai budget local-only off
pai budget status
```

See also: `pai budget status`, `pai budget approve`

### pai budget status

The local-only window and the gatekeeper session, as they stand now

```
pai budget status
```

Prints the open local-only window ("local only until <time>") or that it is off, and which session is the gatekeeper (config key budget.gatekeeper).

```sh
pai budget status
```

### pai budget approve

One-time cloud pass for one worker, from the gatekeeper session only

```
pai budget approve WORKER [options]
```

Writes a one-time approval token the next matching cloud start consumes. Only the configured gatekeeper session (budget.gatekeeper, default "PAI") may approve, and only when it runs this itself.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WORKER` | yes | The worker id or label to let through the window once |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--for DURATION` | string | — | How long the token stands (30m, 2h, 1d; default 2h) |

```sh
pai budget approve 20261118-211428-86670
pai budget approve "fix the retry loop" --for 4h
```

See also: `pai budget local-only`, `pai budget status`
